what_this_is: The three new methods evaluated JOINTLY with the frozen six in one single intersection, i.e. the 'recomputed intersection' variant requested by the 2026-09-21 plan step 4. The files here are copies of the joint run, placed in their own directory so that nothing published is overwritten.

files.common_region_geometry_recomputed.json: geometry of the joint run (per unit: participating methods, their rectangles, the intersection and the grid)
files.S8_EXT_SUMMARY_recomputed.json: the same top-level counters the joint run printed

key_finding: The recomputed intersection is IDENTICAL to the frozen one on all 36 (dataset, category) groups: region_rect and region_grid match the frozen 05_baselines_multi_dataset/common_region_geometry.json for 36/36 units, zero differences. Reason: all three new methods cover the whole original image (rect [0,1]x[0,1], because each of them stretches the image to a square before its backbone), so they are supersets of every frozen method's rectangle and cannot shrink the intersection.
consequence: The six frozen method columns in the extended table are the frozen values to the digit; this was verified twice (see EXT_CHECKS.json): once on the six methods recomputed inside the joint nine-method run (864 rows, 0 mismatches) and once on the six methods replayed alone (864 rows, 0 mismatches).

The caveat in docs/BASELINE_EXPANSION_PLAN_20260921.md 1.2 ('a unit that gains PatchCore/AnomalyDINO later gets a smaller region and a different number') does NOT apply to these three additions, because none of them restricts the region. It WOULD apply to a method whose map covers only a centre crop (e.g. a PatchCore-style Resize+CenterCrop protocol).

The extended table therefore needs no 'do not subtract from Table 11' warning for the frozen columns on numerical grounds; the warning is still carried because the new columns are computed on the shared region and are not comparable to a method's own native frame.
NOT_to_be_confused_with: The frozen table 05_baselines_multi_dataset/baseline_common_region.csv (864 rows, sha256 3c83ab004420a4f836102cabc5f8248debfebc742d8e9602fed0881823a0b8bb) is a different artefact and was not touched.
